items.title: Sync worker double-applies inventory updates on retry
items.notes: Suspected race between the retry path and the update-apply step after a sync job fails partway through. Queued behind BL-1050 and BL-1051, which hold full team capacity through sprints 2026-S19 and 2026-S20. Needs a confirmed reproduction before treating a new client report as the same failure mode.
